title: Fleeing Suspect Shot After Jumping Off RV and Resisting Police Arrest
description:
* (Disclaimer: This video content is intended for educational and informational purposes only) *
Sacramento, California — On Saturday, September 14th, 2024 just after 4:30 p.m., Sacramento Police patrol officers were working in the area of Beloit Drive and Bell Avenue. Officers observed a blue Ford Explorer drive by them in the opposite direction on Beloit Drive. After the two vehicles passed each other, officers saw the individual suddenly park the vehicle and leave it quickly. The officers turned around to further investigate, conducted a records check of the license plate, and found the registration to be expired and suspended. 

The officers began to search for the individual, later identified as 39-year-old Santino Marez of Sacramento. Officers continued searching the area, looking for Marez who abandoned the vehicle. During that time, officers noticed that Marez was lying down on top of a nearby RV. An officer drew his firearm and began giving lawful orders to Marez. Marez stood up, pulled his pants up, and then suddenly jumped off the top of the RV in an attempt to flee. The officers immediately pursued him. Marez resisted the officer and pushed the officer in the chest. During the struggle to place Marez into custody, one round was discharged from an officer’s firearm, grazing the Marez’s head. 

Officers rendered emergency medical aid. The officer sustained scratches to his wrist and knees from the altercation. Marez was transported to an area hospital for treatment. He was discharged from the hospital the following day and was booked into the Sacramento County Main Jail on charges of resisting arrest as well as a felony no-bail warrant for being a felon in possession of a firearm. No weapon was located on Marez when he was taken into custody. During the course of the investigation, officers located illegal narcotics inside of Marez’s vehicle.
